A1.justification: Both PDFs describe REPMD and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A.1–A.8. Relocated and renumbered material can be matched reliably.

before.justification: V1 reports original detection experiments, ablations, human evaluation, and supplementary experiments, including text-to-image safeguarding in Appendix A.7.

after.justification: V2 retains these empirical results and adds a design-concept comparison, a fail-reason-tree ablation, and significance tests.

M1.justification: The fail-reason-tree construction, DCG derivation, SVD pruning, and retrieval-guided detection procedure are retained. Expanded t-hop and graph-to-text explanations document existing operations; the local pruning-specification revision does not establish a different computational procedure.

E1.justification: GOAT-Bench, the 2025 Twitter data, human evaluation, and Qwen-Image safeguarding remain covered. The added Human Specification and Minecraft Replacement study examines concepts already represented in v1, without establishing a new task, domain, or environment.

E2.justification: Corresponding benchmark comparisons retain Mod-Hate, MIND, RA-HMD, and the same vanilla MLLMs. The new concept-focused comparison reuses MIND, RA-HMD, and GPT-4o; it introduces no new baseline method.

E3.justification: V2 adds a manually selected concept study described as 200 memes with a 150/50 construction/test split, and a control constructing DCG directly from all historical memes. Existing benchmark settings remain unchanged. Table 5's separate 50-meme denominators leave the new study's allocation unclear.

E4.justification: V2 adds a quantitative study of two design concepts and a w/o Tree ablation testing the failure-analysis stage. Existing appendix analyses remain. The former DCG-to-Tree and minus-Retrieval ablations retain their descriptions and scores under the potentially confusing labels w/o SVD and w/o DCG.

E5.justification: New Table 3 reports pairwise t-test p-values for REPMD versus vanilla models, OOD versus ID, and temporal-evolving versus temporal-fixed evaluation. V2 adds a p<0.01 significance footnote but does not specify test observations, repeated-run counts, or seeds.

E6.justification: Existing benchmark, human-study, and appendix results remain unchanged. New results include concept-study scores of 44/50 and 47/50 for GPT-4o+REPMD, w/o Tree accuracies of 81.1/79.2/68.1% for ID/OOD/TE, and Table 3's p-values. New Table 5 inconsistently reports RA-HMD's 35/50 as 79.0%.

T1.justification: Algorithm 1 replaces v1's contradictory retained-node exclusion clause with explicit node-to-singular-value notation and an edge-set definition restricted to retained indices. This is a local formal-specification revision; Appendix A.2's assumptions, derivations, theorems, and proofs are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introductory contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about design-concept reproduction, generalization across types and time, detection performance, and assistance to human evaluators.

C2.justification: V2 interprets the new tests as showing significant superiority over vanilla models and nonsignificant losses under distribution shifts. The latter interpretation conflicts with OOD p-values of 0.007 and 0.008 under its significance footnote. The limitations and existing mechanism explanations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 specifies four A6000 GPUs, documents annotation criteria, expands graph-to-text parsing rules in Appendix A.1 and prompt-role explanations in A.8, and replaces the anonymous code/data link with a named GitHub repository link. These disclosures do not establish that existing experiments were rerun.

R1.justification: V2 adds Pandiani et al. (2025), a survey of meme toxicities, as support for annotation criteria. The Related Works section and substantive positioning against prior methods remain unchanged.

P1.justification: V2 makes localized wording and terminology edits, expands pruning and appendix explanations, adds a design-concept case-study heading and acknowledgements, and relabels ablations. The overall narrative and section organization remain largely intact.

P2.justification: V2 adds significance and concept-study tables and expands the ablation table. V1's appendix DCG example, Figure 5, is redrawn and moved into the main text as Figure 3. Other figures, tables, and prompt panels are principally retained and reflowed.

improvement.justification: V2 adds useful component testing, concept-focused evidence, and clearer implementation documentation. However, its new evidence contains an inconsistent percentage and unclear sample allocation in Table 5, while the nonsignificant-shift interpretation contradicts two Table 3 p-values below 0.01. These problems weaken the added validation, leaving the net quality benefit uncertain.
